name: Emerald Editorial
avoid_for: Contexts that need to read as quiet, neutral, or institutionally restrained — the emerald field is too saturated to disappear into the background
weak_cases: Dense technical text and photo-led narratives compete with giant numerals and heavy rules.
visual_signature: Heavy Bodoni mastheads, emerald/navy/paper rectangles and bilateral double rules.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Bodoni contrast and huge numerals are identity-bearing; verify alternative script weights and visual balance.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
